versions.text:
The suitability and durability of materials used in the structure must--
(a) Be established on the basis of experience or tests; and
(b) Conform to approved specifications (such as industry or military specifications, or Technical Standard Orders) that ensure their having the strength and other properties assumed in the design data.

[The suitability and durability of materials used for parts, the failure of which could adversely affect safety, must--]
(a) Be established on the basis of experience or tests; and
(b) Conform to approved specifications, or Technical Standard Orders) that ensure their having the strength and other properties assumed in the design data.
